# REQ: LANG-681 LANG-682 LANG-683 LANG-684
package require Tcl 8.6

proc greet {name {times 1}} {
    # Greets the name.
    set text "Hello, $name!\n"
    set result ""
    for {set i 0} {$i < $times} {incr i} {
        append result $text ; # trailing comment
    }
    return $result
}

set names [list alice bob]
foreach n $names {
    if {[string length $n] > 3} {
        puts [greet $n 2]
    } else {
        puts "short: ${n} #notcomment"
    }
}
set total [expr {0x1F + 1.5}]
